title: Erste Reaktion erkennen
observableEvidence: puck carrier / support / cover reactions as situational functions
evaluationFocus: marks the switch and the first visible reaction
describes change over time (before → after), not a static state
scopes claim to the observed sequence window
requiredForStrong: identifies a transition moment and the first reaction
avoids tempo jargon without sequence anchors
does not turn one switch into a team identity
commonFailureModes: static structure with no temporal change
outcome bias from the next chance/goal
all skate forward = assumed structured transition
fairnessNote: A clear single-sequence observation can reach excellent. Multi-scene synthesis is not required for high quality here.
minimalInputChange: Primary answers are selects. Optional note ≤150 chars is too thin. Minimal: require a short free-text (≈60–150 chars) describing the first reaction sequence, or keep structured-only from selects.
